tagline: Around the reservoir from Powell's launching place.
intro: Out of Green River, WYO 530 goes south as West Flaming Gorge Road, keeping to the west side of the river and then of Flaming Gorge Reservoir for some 45 miles to the Utah line. The loop comes back north on US 191, East Flaming Gorge Road, through 51 miles of rugged desert country to Rock Springs. All told it is about 100 miles, three hours at the least.
The reservoir is the river held back. Its dam at Red Canyon in Utah was finished in 1964, and the water now lies in a narrow canyon of sandstone and quartzite on both sides of the state line.

moments.title: Green River
moments.text: Finding a town already here in 1868, the railroad moved its division point west to Bryan, then moved it back when Blacks Fork dried up, and Bryan became the ghost town.

moments.title: Expedition Island
moments.text: A park on an island in the Green River, with a stone marker where John Wesley Powell set off down the Green and the Colorado in 1871, and probably in 1869 as well.

moments.title: Flaming Gorge Reservoir
moments.text: South of town the highway runs down the west side of the reservoir, past public camp sites at Buckboard Marina.
